meta.title: Illustrative end-of-life factors
meta.status: ILLUSTRATIVE — prototype screening values, not certified LCA data
meta.note: Emissions from treating 1 kg of discarded material. Recycling uses the cut-off approach: only collection and sorting are counted and NO credit is given for avoided virgin production, because the benefit of recycled content is already counted when a product uses recycled material. This prevents double-counting. Incineration counts fossil carbon only; no energy-recovery credit is given.

units.factor: kg CO2e per kg of material treated

basis: Illustrative; landfill values for bio-based materials reflect partial methane generation, incineration of polymers reflects fossil carbon content.
